# Alliance for Science

> Global advocacy organization promoting science-based solutions for agricultural innovation, food security, and sustainable development in Africa and Bangladesh.

Alliance for Science works to advance evidence-based agricultural biotechnology and science communication across developing regions. The organization supports farmer empowerment, climate resilience, and misinformation fact-checking through fellowships, partnerships, and community-led initiatives.

## Key Topics

- Agricultural biotechnology
- Food security
- Science advocacy
- Climate change
- Agricultural innovation
- Science communication
- Evidence-based policy
- Africa
- Bangladesh
- Farmer empowerment
- Genetic engineering
- Global leadership
- International network
- Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation
- Misinformation fact-checking

## About the Organization

- [Alliance for Science](https://allianceforscience.org): Alliance for Science homepage promoting science innovation in Africa and Bangladesh
- [Who We Are](https://allianceforscience.org/about): Organization overview of Alliance for Science's mission and advocacy work
- [Our Mission](https://allianceforscience.org/about/mission): Mission statement addressing global challenges through science advocacy
- [Our Funders](https://allianceforscience.org/about/funders): List of major funders including Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation
- [Staff Directory](https://allianceforscience.org/team): Staff directory featuring team members including Mark Lynas and leadership
- [Our Allies](https://allianceforscience.org/about/our-allies): Partnership and fellowship program information for community engagement

## Flagship Programs

- [Farming Future Bangladesh](https://allianceforscience.org/farming-future-bangladesh): Agricultural innovation initiative in Bangladesh promoting crop improvement
- [Women Who Farm Africa](https://allianceforscience.org/women-who-farm-africa): Women empowerment and leadership initiative for African farmers
- [Science Stories Africa](https://allianceforscience.org/science-stories-africa): Science communication platform for African storytelling and genetic engineering
